%doc: Source-of-truth manifest of the SMW properties Module:Company emits via getStructuredData -> mw.smw.set. Multi-value fields are SEMICOLON-separated. Page-type properties (Founder, Subsidiaries, Area served, Parent company, Predecessor, Successor) store the wikilink TARGET(s); the list-valued ones (Founder, Subsidiaries, Area served, Predecessor, Successor) are semicolon-split into one value per item. Headquarters stores one star system per HQ: the last wikilink of each semicolon-separated HQ segment (convention 'place, ..., system'). Area served stores every served place (each semicolon item's link target, not collapsed to system); fill it only when narrower than the whole UEE (a bare 'United Empire of Earth' carries no signal). Industry/Products store the per-item delink + lcfirst display label, semicolon-split. Founded is the clean year (the module renders the date via {{Start date and age}} for display only). Display-only fields (Key people, Fate, Defunct, Formerly, Allies, Rivals) are intentionally absent. Plain SMW, not Buckets. Subject type is a source-free constant (no source key); its default fires on every Company page, marking the page subject so companies are queryable cross-module via [[Subject type::Company]].
